verses.text: Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.

segments.text: Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.

verses.text: O my soul, thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.

verses.text: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.

segments.text: As for the saints that are in the earth,
They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.

verses.text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another god: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.

verses.text: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

segments.text: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup:
Thou maintainest my lot.

verses.text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.

segments.text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places;

verses.text: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.

verses.text: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

segments.text: I have set Jehovah always before me:

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: My flesh also shall dwell in safety.

segments.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth:

verses.text: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.

verses.text: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
